prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for both 'adoption, new_flow' and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as each has only 1 test.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, new_flow' changes.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -5.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] sign_in_existing_account_clarity: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen clarifying how to sign in with an existing account to avoid creating duplicate empty accounts. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, pointing to account sign-in confusion.)
1: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_progress_estimate: Enable time estimates and progress indicators on the waiting screen while the pet is being prepared. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off before pet delivery.)
2: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_visibility_check: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing desktop verification steps. (why: 3 support emails mentioned pets not displaying on desktop after completing setup, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
3: [choose_path, layout] story_screen_split_layout: Switch the intro story screen to a split layout highlighting companion choices visually. (why: The choose_path stage has 76.2% conversion and a mean duration of 514s, indicating slow initial user orientation.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_after_pick_friend: Reorder sign-in to occur right after pet selection instead of before path choice. (why: Sign-in has 72.9% conversion early on; letting users pick their pet first builds motivation before sign-in.)
5: [home, notification] waiting_ready_notification: Enable desktop notification opt-in on the waiting screen so users know when generation is complete. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s, leading users to leave the desktop app unattended or get lost.)
6: [finish, hint] home_intro_interaction_tips: Add clear hint text on the home intro screen detailing mouse shortcuts for pet controls. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
7: [choose_path, copy] choose_path_clear_option_descriptions: Update copy on choose_path screen to explicitly distinguish between pre-made pets and custom photo pets. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean time of 514s, indicating confusion between path choices.)
